sample_unit: query responders (4 AI platforms and 2 clinical experts)

links.outcome: Validity of AI recommendation for surgical instrument reprocessing versus expert recommendation and literature
links.effect: Only ChatGPT matched the experts' chlorine dioxide recommendation; GenAI.mil and Gemini recommended OPA and NIPRGPT recommended glutaraldehyde, prioritizing processing speed over sterility assurance.
links.quote: Clinical experts recommended chlorine dioxide (ClO2) due to its sporicidal properties, which ensure sterility assurance. Only ChatGPT matched this recommendation.

screen.reason: Evaluates multiple generative AI platforms against clinical expert recommendations for surgical instrument reprocessing protocols in austere military health environments.
